A private draft. A clear boundary.

By Max Fisher · Draft for review · 2026-10-29

This is a website concept for MBRACE INSIGHT. Service descriptions and editorial material are drafts for review. The sample brief is illustrative and does not represent a real project or customer result.

Your starting brief

The interactive planner uses your selections in this browser to create a text download. Its application code does not send those selections to MBRACE, create an account, or subscribe you to a mailing list. It does not save your selections after a reload.

Site access and hosting

This draft is hosted through Sites with private access. The hosting provider may process technical access information to deliver and protect the site; this page is not a substitute for the provider’s privacy terms.

Images and external sources

The rooftop photograph is AI-generated illustrative imagery. Fonts are served with the site. External reference links open third-party websites, which have their own practices.

Before a public launch

Confirm service scope, contact and intake routing, editorial review, privacy terms, and any commercial or referral disclosures. A subscription, live project feed, client dashboard, or CRM connection is not active in this concept.
